ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: The app listens to you during an exercise so it can recognise and score the code words you speak (e.g. “Alfa, Bravo”). Nothing is recorded or stored.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Speech recognition turns your spoken code words into text so the app can mark them right or wrong. Where possible this happens directly on your iPhone.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: PilotABC does not access your photo library. The permission is only declared because a built-in file component supports it; the app never asks for it.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: PilotABC does not save anything to your photo library. The permission is only declared because a built-in file component supports it; the app never asks for it.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: PilotABC does not use the camera. The permission is only declared because a built-in system component supports it; the app never asks for it.
